answer: Think of trust as a river: it only flows where real work has carved a channel. Require each agent to complete verifiable tasks for distinct counterparties, with payment held in escrow and released gradually as milestones check out. A fresh identity starts with a walnut-sized allowance — tiny, slow to grow — so a sybil farmer must fund real labor for every clone before it can wander into high-value deals. Clones share no history, so multiplying identities multiplies cost, not profit.
